method: Built-in image_gen; sips JPEG conversion and exact 1664 × 936 export.

k1.initial:
Use case: stylized-concept. Paint one production concept keyframe by editing the supplied actual game capture. Output a single 16:9 landscape image, requested 1664 x 936. Input A and B are camera, boat, characters, rendering references; use B's rear camera with a modest hint of A's rear three-quarter boat visibility. Match the reference game's soft stylised 3D, simple rounded shapes, blue painterly sea, warm afternoon sun glitter at right, pale gold haze. Do NOT turn this into an illustration postcard or close-up.
CAMERA LOCK: camera behind boat about 24 metres back and 6.5 metres up looking forward. Horizon at 19% image height. Boat lower middle, hull around x45–54%, y57–67%, mast top at 28%. Boat stays small exactly like captures; do not zoom in. Same small rounded wooden dinghy, dark mast, cream/yellow patchwork sail of reference, now slack, no replacement vessel. No active sailing wake.
ENCOUNTER: 14-metre huge asleep whale lies broadside across route 7 metres beyond the boat's forward flank clearance, body across the middle distance. Whale head to screen LEFT, tail to RIGHT, body spans approximately x13–82%, top of low domed back y41%, waterline y52%; boat remains in front without obscuring head/blowhole. Long low island of smooth dark slate-blue back with a pale underside barely visible along near waterline; very simple rounded whale forms, closed tiny eye at left, few small barnacles, not photoreal or cartoon-faced. Whole body lying horizontal in water, NOT beached, NOT jumping. Near-side blowhole left of sail, subtle breath mist only 0.7 metre above back. A single small gull asleep on back to left of centre. Small girl 1.1m tall orange hooded coat red scarf seated inside boat leans over left gunwale toward whale, seen from rear; brown satchel with baby GREY swan half hidden behind flap, grey head and long grey neck peeking out, left wing bandaged. No one looks at camera. Tiny distant grey meadow island in warm haze at far right, less distinct than reference.
Moment: complete stillness, sleeping whale, slack sail, curious child, cautious cygnet, small breath mist. Water gap between hull and whale obvious.
No text, panels, UI, labels, cursor, hands representing player, logo, sparkles, magic, glowing effects, extra people, extra boats. No wind lines yet. Beautiful, calm, physically buildable realtime Three.js scene. Preserve reference camera and boat more strongly than illustrative drama.
k1.refinement: Edit this concept keyframe with only these small pose and cloth changes; lock the existing camera, horizon, whale shape/size/location, boat size/location, lighting and style exactly. The girl is seated in the dinghy and distinctly leans her orange hood and upper body LEFT out over the left gunwale, looking at the whale, one hand resting over that gunwale. Her brown satchel is on her back; the little GREY cygnet has HALF DUCKED inside it, body fully hidden behind its open brown flap, only a small grey head and short visible part of its long neck peeking just above the flap. The bird must look cautiously hidden, not sitting outside bag. Left wing bandage mostly hidden inside bag. Gull on whale is asleep with head tucked into its feathers, legs relaxed. Yellow cream patchwork sail keeps exactly the same shape/mast/boom but is visibly slack with two soft sagging folds and curled leech, not filled by wind. Everything else unchanged. Single 16:9 1664x936 image, no text/UI.

k2:
Use case stylized-concept. Edit the supplied sleeping-whale concept into the very next keyframe, THE TICKLE. Preserve camera, horizon, framing, boat and whale scale and placement, sea, lighting, character models, patchwork slack sail. Single landscape 16:9, 1664x936.
The player has just swept wind left to right along the whale's broad low back. Draw only THREE fine soft white near-horizontal wind streaks, a little curved, just 0.15–0.4m above the whale's skin, left of the mast. These are short delicate directional air lines, NOT luminous ribbons, NO glitter. A subtle shallow skin ripple follows underneath as three soft creases/highlight undulations on the back, not a new body part.
The whale remains asleep: same tiny closed eye, same relaxed long rounded head on LEFT and tail RIGHT. Its ONE anatomically attached near pectoral flipper originates behind the head on near side at about x30% and sweeps down and right towards x43%, a long tapered rounded paddle about 3m long. Catch it lazily slapping the surface, tip at water level, trailing edge partly lifted 0.6m. A small physical fan of white water and droplets travels toward boat across the gap, max 0.9m high, no giant wave. Keep whale head and blowhole and child readable. Gull has hopped just 0.4m off back, wings half spread, above its original position around x40%, visibly reacting rather than flying away.
Girl seated in orange hooded coat and red scarf eases back slightly from left rail but still leans curious toward the whale. Baby grey swan peeks from open brown satchel, grey beak in profile pointing left toward whale, never at viewer; bandaged left wing stays mostly inside bag. Boat remains stopped with slack sail and calm water at stern. Beautiful gentle humour, calm and safe.
Do not add cursors, hand icons, text, UI, magic, glow, sparkles, extra animals, extra flippers or a facial smile. Exact same stylised realtime 3D game style as image.
k3:
Use case stylized-concept. Edit supplied sleeping whale keyframe to the waking breath moment. EXACT same locked crossing camera, horizon height, sea and lighting, small lower-middle boat, whale position/shape/size, head LEFT tail RIGHT. This is frame three of same shot, not a new viewpoint. Output single landscape 16:9 1664x936.
Whale opens its tiny near eye: a small dark calm glint, natural small eye NOT cartoon face. Back lifts gently with inhalation, 0.15m at most. Blowhole remains at same position x24%, y32% on the near-side left part of whale's back, safely clear of mast. From that exact opening shoots a tall narrow PLUME OF REAL WHITE WATER SPRAY, 4.5m above back, reaching around y6% image height. Thin stem, airy irregular droplets widening to 1.3m across near top, gravity falling outward in soft feathered mist. NOT a tree, geyser explosion, cloud tower or solid white shape. Add a FAINT incomplete rainbow only in the sunlit right edge of spray, delicate pale colours, not a full rainbow arch.
Player has circled directly over blowhole: draw just TWO OR THREE extremely fine translucent soft WHITE HELICAL ARC fragments circling the lower plume, 1.4m diameter, reaching 2m above back. Clear quiet curved airflow geometry, no base ring on water, no luminous trail, no magic, no particles except real spray. The white spray is the main vertical event; thin faint wind lines are secondary and sparse.
Girl in orange hood and red scarf seated inside reference wooden dinghy looks up and left at plume, face away from camera; brown satchel on back, small grey cygnet lifts its long grey neck cautiously out of bag to look left at spray, body still in bag. No one faces viewer. Sail same slack cream/yellow patchwork cloth, mast and boom unchanged. Gull on back now awake, looking toward plume, ordinary tiny gull. Whale pectoral flipper below water; splash from previous beat settled. All calm, beautiful soft rounded stylised realtime 3D with painterly sea, not photorealism.
No text, UI, cursor, hand icons, glowing effects, sparkles, additional animals or boats.
k4:
Use case stylized-concept. Edit supplied sleeping-whale concept into fourth keyframe GOODBYE, later in same continuous shot. Preserve EXACT crossing camera, horizon at 20%, unchanged atmosphere, afternoon sea glitter at right, small boat at lower middle same scale, identical wooden dinghy mast cream/yellow patchwork sail orange hooded girl red scarf brown satchel grey baby swan. Single landscape 16:9 1664x936.
The whale has rolled AWAY from boat and is diving headfirst, beyond boat. Remove sleeping horizontal whale head and back entirely. In its place the sea is opening smooth and empty except a receding broad slate-blue shoulder barely visible UNDER water at left of centre, and its tail stock and TWO connected symmetrical broad WHALE FLUKES raised high near x64%, y30–44%, clearly to RIGHT of sail with clean gap. Tail stock emerges at x64%, y46%. Flukes are about 5m tip to tip, highest tip 3.5m above water, dark slate-blue upper edge and paler bluish-grey underside, smooth simple rounded tapered lobes with central notch. Tail fan faces generally back toward boat, slight lazy roll like a farewell wave, anatomically whale flukes, not two fins or wings. Several thin ordinary water streams and droplets drip from edges into calm foam below. Whale is sinking, not breaching; body submerged. No face in flukes.
A single broad LOW rounded swell travels from dive toward camera, crosses beneath boat, gently lifts hull 0.35m and rolls it 5 degrees. Show curved bands of raised sunlit water approaching and passing under hull; NO breaking surf, tsunami or dramatic splash. Boat has no forward wake yet. Preserve gap from whale; tail root 12m ahead of boat and 4m to right.
Girl stays SEATED facing away, raises LEFT arm above shoulder with small open hand waving toward tail on right, orange hood looking right, red scarf hangs loose. CyGNET is now ALL THE WAY OUT of brown satchel, perched securely on rear left gunwale immediately beside girl's back, whole small round GREY fluffy body visible and long grey neck stretched upward looking toward departing whale at right, LEFT wing visibly wrapped with narrow cream bandage, wings folded. No extra bird in satchel. Little gull from whale airborne in upper middle distance, flying off quietly. No one looks at camera.
Wind gesture finished, NO wind lines or spiral, no rainbow, no spout. No text UI cursor magic glow extra people boats or animals. Calm beautiful gentle goodbye in same soft stylised realtime 3D game rendering.
